newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria warns Albania could destabilise region.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria warns Albania could destabilise region.

text.p: Bulgaria on Tuesday called for an international effort to resolve the crisis in Albania and warned that the entire Balkan region could suffer if it failed.

"The development of the situation in Albania requires urgent and effective measures by the international community and especially the European Union and the OSCE with a key role by the United States in this process," foreign ministry spokesman Radko Vlaikov said in a statement.

"In order to calm the explosive situation in the country, it is important to combine diplomatic efforts with securing of urgent humanitarian aid with the assistance of international financial institutions.
"Bulgaria is appealing to all governments of countries neighbouring Albania to cooperate in halting the expansion of the conflict and the potential destabilisation of the region."
The Albanian government imposed a state of emergency after riots by investors enraged by the collapse of pyramid savings schemes.
Other Balkan states fear unrest could spread to ethnic Albanian populations in neighbouring countries.
